references.text: Describes the event where the angel speaks to the women at Jesus' tomb
The angel gives the women the message that Jesus has risen
Angels explain Jesus' resurrection to the women
Mary Magdalene sees two angels in Jesus' empty tomb
The exhortation not to fear, given by the angel, reflects God's word to his people
God's assurance to Jacob of his presence and protection, parallel to the angel's assurance to the women
